G1909.def:
**ἐπί** (before a smooth breathing ἐπ᾽, before a rough breathing ἐφ᾽),
_prep._ with genitive, dative, accusative (accusative most frequently in NT),
with primary sense of superposition, **on, upon**.
I. C. genitive,
1. of place, answering the question, where?
(a) of the place on which, **on, upon**: ἐπὶ (τ.) γῆς, [[Mat.6.10, 19|Mat.6:10, 19]], al.; τ. κεφαλῆς, [[1Co.11.10|1Co.11:10]] τ. νεφελῶν, [[Mat.24.3|Mat.24:3]]o, al.; like ἐν, in constr. praegn. after verbs of motion: βάλλειν, [[Mrk.4.26|Mrk.4:26]] σπείρειν, ib. 31; ἔρχεσθαι, [[Heb.6.7|Heb.6:7]], al.; figuratively, ἐπ᾽ ἀληθείας (MM, see word ἀ.); of the subject of thought or speech, [[Gal.3.16|Gal.3:16]] of power or authority, **over**, πάντων, [[Rom.9.5:|Rom.9:5:]] τ. γάζης, [[Act.8.27|Act.8:27]] ἐξουσία, [[Rev.2.26; 20.6|Rev.2:26 20:6]];
(b) of vicinity, **at, by**: τ. θαλάσσης, [[Jhn.6.9|Jhn.6:9]] τ. ὁδοῦ, [[Mat.21.19|Mat.21:19]] τοῦ βάτου, [[Mrk.12.26|Mrk.12:26]] (see Swete, in l.); with genitive of person(s), **in the presence of, before**, [[Mat.28.14|Mat.28:14]], [[Act.23.30|Act.23:30]], [[1Co.6.1|1Co.6:1]], al.
2. Of time,
(a) with genitive of person(s), **in the time of**: ἐπὶ Ἐλισαίου, [[Luk.4.27|Luk.4:27]] ἐπὶ Κλαυδίου, [[Act.11.28|Act.11:28]] ἐπὶ Ἀβιάθαρ ἀρχιερέως, **when A. was high priest**, [[Mrk.2.26|Mrk.2:26]]
(b) with genitive of thing(s), **at, at the time of**: [[Mat.1.11|Mat.1:11]], [[Heb.1.2|Heb.1:2]], [[2Pe.3.3|2Pe.3:3]]; ἐπὶ τ. προσευχῶν, [[Rom.1.10|Rom.1:10]], [[Eph.1.16|Eph.1:16]], [[1Th.1.2|1Th.1:2]], Phm 4.
II. C. dative, of place, answering the question, where?
(a) lit., **on, upon**: [[Mat.9.16; 14.8|Mat.9:16, 14:8]], al.; after verbs of motion (see supr., I, 1, (_a_)), [[Mat.9.16|Mat.9:16]] [[Act.8.16|Act.8:16]]; **above**, [[Luk.23.38|Luk.23:38]] **at, by**, [[Mrk.13.29|Mrk.13:29]], [[Jhn.5.2|Jhn.5:2]], [[Act.5.9|Act.5:9]], al.;
(b) metaphorically, **upon, on the ground of**, [[Luk.4.4|Luk.4:4]] (LXX); **in the matter of**, [[Mrk.6.52|Mrk.6:52]] (see Swete, in l.); **upon, of, concerning**, [[Act.5.35, 40|Act.5:35, 40]]; of the ground, reason or motive (Bl., §38, 2; 43, 3), [[Mat.18.3; 19.9|Mat.18:3 19:9]], [[Rom.12.12|Rom.12:12]], al.; ἐφ᾽ ᾧ, **for the reason that, because**, [[Rom.5.12|Rom.5:12]] [[2Co.5.4|2Co.5:4]]; after verbs of motion, **over**, [[Mat.18.13|Mat.18:13]], [[Rom.16.19|Rom.16:19]], al.; of a condition (cl.), [[Rom.8.20|Rom.8:20]], [[1Co.9.10|1Co.9:10]]; ἐπὶ δυσὶ μάρτυσιν (see Westc. on [[Heb.9.10|Heb.9:10]]), [[Heb.10.28|Heb.10:28]]; of purpose or aim, [[Eph.2.10|Eph.2:10]], [[Php.4.10|Php.4:10]]; of authority, **over**, [[Mat.24.47|Mat.24:47]] [[Luk.12.44|Luk.12:44]]; of hostility, with dative of person(s) (cl.), **against**, [[Luk.12.52|Luk.12:52]] **in addition to** (cl.), [[2Co.7.13|2Co.7:13]] of an adjunct, **in, at, on**, [[Php.1.3; 2.17|Php.1:3 2:17]].
III. C. accusative,
1. of place of motion upon or over, answering the question, whither?
(a) lit., **upon, over**: [[Mat.14.28, 29|Mat.14:28, 29]], [[Luk.5.19|Luk.5:19]], al. mult.; in NT also, answering the question, where? (as with genitive, dative), [[Mrk.4.38; 11.2|Mrk.4:38 11:2]], [[Luk.2.25|Luk.2:25]], [[Jhn.1.32|Jhn.1:32]]; ἐπὶ τ. αὐτό, [[Act.1.15; 2.1|Act.1:15 2:1]], al.; of motion to a vicinity, **to**, [[Mrk.16.2|Mrk.16:2]], [[Act.8.36|Act.8:36]], al.;
(b) metaphorically (in wh. "the accusative is more widely prevalent than it strictly should be," Bl., §43, 1); of blessings, evils, etc., coming upon one, with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.10.13; 12.28|Mat.10:13 12:28]], [[Act.2.17|Act.2:17]], [[Jhn.18.4|Jhn.18:4]], [[Eph.5.6|Eph.5:6]], al.; of addition (dative in cl.), λύπη ἐπὶ λύπην, [[Php.2.27|Php.2:27]] ἐπικαλεῖν ὄνομα ἐπί (see: ἐπικαλέω), [[Act.15.17|Act.15:17]], [[Jas.2.7|Jas.2:7]]; καλεῖν ἐπί, **to call after**, [[Luk.1.59|Luk.1:59]] of number or degree: ἐπὶ τρίς (cl. εἰς τ.), **thrice**, [[Act.10.16; 11.10|Act.10:16 11:10]]; ἐπὶ πλεῖον, **the more, further**, [[Act.4.17|Act.4:17]] [[2Ti.2.16; 3.9|2Ti.2:16 3:9]] (see also infr., 2, (_a_)); ἐφ᾽ ὅσον (see infr., ib.), **forasmuch as**, [[Mat.25.40, 45|Mat.25:40, 45]], [[Rom.11.13|Rom.11:13]]; of power, authority, control, [[Luk.1.33|Luk.1:33]], [[Act.7.10|Act.7:10]] [[Rom.5.14|Rom.5:14]], [[Heb.3.6|Heb.3:6]], al.; of the direction of thoughts and feelings, **unto, towards**, [[Luk.1.17; 23.28|Luk.1:17 23:28]], [[Act.9.35, 42|Act.9:35, 42]], [[Rom.11.22|Rom.11:22]], [[Gal.4.9|Gal.4:9]], [[Eph.2.7|Eph.2:7]], [[1Ti.5.5|1Ti.5:5]], al.; of purpose, **for**, [[Mat.3.7|Mat.3:7]], [[Luk.23.48|Luk.23:48]]; ἐφ᾽ ὅ πάρει (Rec. ἐφ᾽ ᾧ, [[Mat.26.50|Mat.26:50]] of hostility, **against**, [[Mat.24.7|Mat.24:7]], [[Mrk.3.24-26; 10.11; 13.8|Mrk.3:24-26 10:11 13:8]], [[Luk.9.5|Luk.9:5]], [[Jhn.13.18|Jhn.13:18]], [[Act.7.54|Act.7:54]], [[1Co.7.36|1Co.7:36]], [[2Co.1.23|2Co.1:23]]; Of reference, **concerning, for** (cl. usually dative), [[Mrk.9.12; 15.24|Mrk.9:12 15:24]], [[Jhn.19.24|Jhn.19:24]], [[Rom.4.9|Rom.4:9]].
2. Of time,
(a) **during, for**: [[Luk.4.25|Luk.4:25]] (WH, txt., omits ἐπί), [[Act.13.31; 16.18|Act.13:31 16:18]], [[Heb.11.30|Heb.11:30]], al.; ἐφ᾽ ὅσον (χρόνον), **as long as, for so long time as**, [[Mrk.9.15|Mrk.9:15]] [[Rom.7.1|Rom.7:1]], al. (for ἐφ᾽ ὅ in another sense, see supr., 1, (_b_)); ἐφ᾽ ἱκανόν (see: ἱ), [[Act.20.11|Act.20:11]] ἐπὶ πλεῖον (see supr., 1, (b)), **yet longer, further**, [[Act.20.9; 24.4|Act.20:9 24:4]];
(b) **on, about, towards** (cl. εἰς): [[Luk.10.35|Luk.10:35]] [[Act.3.1; 4.5|Act.3:1 4:5]].
IV. **In composition, ἐπί signifies**: **up**, ἐπαίρω; **upon**, ἐπίγειος, ἐπιδημέω, ὠπικαθίζω; **towards**, επιβλέπω, ὠπεκτείνω; **over** (of superintendence), ἐπιστάτης; **again, in addition**, ἐπαιτέω; **against**, ἐπιορκέω, ἐπιβουλή.
(AS)

G1937.def:
**ἐπιθυμέω**, -ῶ
(θυμός), [in LXX chiefly for אָוָה pi., hithp.; also for חָמַד, etc. ;]
**to set one's heart upon, desire, lust after, covet**: absol., [[Jas.4.2|Jas.4:2]], [[Rom.7.7; 13.9|Rom.7:7 13:9]]" (LXX), [[1Co.10.6|1Co.10:6]] (of. [[4Ma.2.6|4Ma.2:6]]); before κατά (against, in opposition to), [[Gal.5.17|Gal.5:17]] prop. (as in cl.) with genitive, [[Act.20.33|Act.20:33]], [[1Ti.3.1|1Ti.3:1]]; in late Gk. also with accusative (M, _Pr._, 65), [[Mat.5.28|Mat.5:28]] (Rec. αὐτῆς; T omits; cf. [[Exo.20.17|Exo.20:17]], [[Mic.2.2|Mic.2:2]], [[Wis.16.3|Wis.16:3]], al.); with inf., [[Mat.13.17|Mat.13:17]], [[Luk.15.16; 16.21; 17.22|Luk.15:16 16:21 17:22]], [[1Pe.1.12|1Pe.1:12]], [[Rev.9.6|Rev.9:6]]; with accusative and inf., [[Heb.6.11|Heb.6:11]] as in Hebrew, ἐπιθυμία ἐπεθύμησα, [[Luk.22.15|Luk.22:15]]†
_SYN._: ὀρέγω (cf. Field, _Notes_, 204), θέλω (_DCG_. i, 453) (AS)

G1964.def:
**ἐπιορκέω**, -ῶ
(ἐπίορκος), [in LXX: I [[Est.1.48|Est.1:48]], [[Wis.14.28|Wis.14:28]] * ;]
**to swear falsely, forswear oneself**: [[Mat.5.33|Mat.5:33]]†
(AS)

G1967.def:
**ἐπιούσιος**, -ον
(cf. περιούσιος, [in LXX for סְגֻלָּה, etc.]),
found only in the phrase ἄρτος ἐ., EV, daily; R, mg., **for the coming day**: [[Mat.6.11|Mat.6:11]], [[Luk.11.3|Luk.11:3]]. (Several derivations find support, each pointing to a different meaning.
1. ἐπιοῦσα (sc. ἡμέρα) (or, ἐπὶ τὴν ἰοῦσαν (sc. ήμέραν), Zorell, see word), hence, for the morrow or for the coming day (R, mg.).
2. (a) ἐπί + οὐσία, hence, for subsistence, needful (Am. R, mg.);
(b) ἐπί + εἶναι in fern. ptcp. form, hence, pertaining to (the day). For renderings of versions and views of various writers, see reff. in _DB_, _ext._, 36 f.; _DCG_, ii, 58 f., 62a; _ICC_ on Lk, l.with The EV, daily, is based on the Vg. (Lk; OL, Mt, Lk, quotidianus). "It is difficult not to think that τὸν ἐ. rests upon misunderstanding of an original Aramaic phrase, or upon a Greek corruption" (_ICC_ on Mt, l.with; cf. also Cremer, 239).†
(AS)

G1934.def:
**ἐπι-ζητέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for דָּרַשׁ, [[4Ki.8.8|4Ki.8:8]], [[Isa.62.12|Isa.62:12]], al.; also for בָּקַשׁ, [[3Ki.20.1|3Ki.20:1]], [[Ecc.7.28|Ecc.7:28]]), [[Hos.3.5|Hos.3:5]]; פָּקַד, [[2Ki.3.8|4Ki.3:8]] ;]
"directive" of ζητέω (MM, _Exp._, xiv),
**to inquire for, seek after, wish for**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.6.32; 12.39; 16.4|Mat.6:32 12:39 16:4]], [[Luk.12.30|Luk.12:30]], [[Act.19.39|Act.19:39]], [[Rom.11.7|Rom.11:7]], [[Php.4.17|Php.4:17]], [[Heb.11.14; 13.14|Heb.11:14 13:14]]; with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.4.42|Luk.4:42]], [[Act.12.19|Act.12:19]]; with inf., [[Act.13.7|Act.13:7]]†
(AS)

G1929.def:
**ἐπι-δίδωμι **
[in LXX for נָתַן, etc. ;]
1. **to give over, to hand**: with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[Mat.7.9, 19|Mat.7:9, 19]], [[Luk.11.11-12; 24.30, 42|Luk.11:11-12 24:30, 42]], [[Act.15.30|Act.15:30]]; pass. with dative of person(s), [[Luk.4.17|Luk.4:17]]
2. **to give in, give way**: absol., [[Act.27.15|Act.27:15]]†
(AS)

G1921.def:
**ἐπι-γινώσκω **
[in LXX chiefly for נָכַר: hi., also for יָדַע, etc. ;]
"directive" of γινώσκω (AR, _Eph._, 249), as in cl.;
1. **to observe, perceive, discern, recognize**;
(a) absol.: [[Act.25.10|Act.25:10]], [[1Co.13.12|1Co.13:12]]; before ὅτι, [[Luk.1.22|Luk.1:22]] τ. πνεύματι, before ὅτι, [[Mrk.2.8|Mrk.2:8]]
(b) with accusative of thing(s): [[Luk.1.4; 5.22|Luk.1:4 5:22]], [[Act.12.14; 27.39|Act.12:14 27:39]], [[Rom.1.32|Rom.1:32]], [[2Co.1.13|2Co.1:13]], [[Col.1.6|Col.1:6]], [[1Ti.4.3|1Ti.4:3]]; ἐν ἐαυτῷ, [[Mrk.5.30|Mrk.5:30]] before ὅτι, [[1Co.14.37|1Co.14:37]]
(with) with accusative of person(s): [[Mat.11.27; 14.36; 17.12|Mat.11:27 14:36 17:12]], [[Mrk.6.33|Mrk.6:33]] (T, αὐτούς, but LTr., WH, R, omit the prop., and LTr., WH, txt., read ἔγνωσαν), [[Mrk.6.54|Mrk.6:54]] [[Luk.24.16, 31|Luk.24:16, 31]], [[1Co.16.18|1Co.16:18]], [[2Co.1.14|2Co.1:14]]; before ἀπό, with genitive of thing(s), [[Mat.7.16, 20|Mat.7:16, 20]]; before ὅτι, [[Act.3.10; 4.13|Act.3:10 4:13]], [[2Co.13.5|2Co.13:5]]; pass., [[1Co.13.12|1Co.13:12]] opposite to ἀγνοούμενοι, [[2Co.6.9|2Co.6:9]]
2. **to discover, ascertain, determine**: [[Act.9.30|Act.9:30]] before ὅτι, [[Luk.7.37; 23.7|Luk.7:37 23:7]], [[Act.19.34; 22.29; 24.11; 28.1|Act.19:34 22:29 24:11 28:1]]; with accusative of thing(s), before quæst., [[Act.23.28|Act.23:28]] δι᾽ ἣν αἰτίαν, [[Act.22.24|Act.22:24]] παρά, with genitive of person(s), before περ, with genitive of thing(s), [[Act.24.8|Act.24:8]] τ. ὁδὸν τῆς δικαιοσύνης, [[2Pe.2.21|2Pe.2:21]] (cf. Lft., Col., 136; Cremer, 159; M, _Pr._, 113; AR, _Eph._, 248 ff.).†
(AS)

G1911.def:
**ἐπι-βάλλω **
[in LXX for שָׁלַח, שִׁית, etc. ;]
1. trans., **to cast, lay or put upon**: with accusative and dative, [[Mrk.11.7|Mrk.11:7]], [[1Co.7.35|1Co.7:35]]; with accusative, before ἐπί with accusative, [[Rev.18.10|Rev.18:10]], WH, mg.; τ. Χεῖρα (-ας) ἐπί (B1., § 37, 7), of seizing a prisoner, [[Mat.26.50|Mat.26:50]], [[Luk.20.19; 21.12|Luk.20:19 21:12]], [[Jhn.7.30|Jhn.7:30]], [[Act.5.18; 21.27|Act.5:18 21:27]]; with dative (Polyb.), [[Mrk.14.46|Mrk.14:46]] [[Act.4.3|Act.4:3]]; with inf., [[Act.12.1|Act.12:1]] τὴν χ. ἐπ᾽ ἄροτρον, [[Luk.9.62|Luk.9:62]] ἐπίβλημα ἐπὶ ἱμάτιον, [[Luk.5.36|Luk.5:36]] ἐπὶ ἱματίῳ, [[Mat.9.16|Mat.9:16]]
2. Intrans.,
(a) **to throw oneself or rush upon**: τ. κύματα εἰς τ. πλοῖον, [[Mrk.4.37|Mrk.4:37]] metaphorically, to put one's mind upon (but see Field, _Notes_, 41 ff.), ἐπιβαλὼν ἔκλαιεν, when he thought thereon (sc. τ. ῥήματι), **he wept **(EV, txt.; R, mg., he began to weep; cf. M, _Pr._, 131): [[Mrk.14.72|Mrk.14:72]] (see also Swete, in l);
(b) **to fall to one's share**: τὸ ἐπιβάλλον (sc. dative; Hdt., a1., a technical formula frequently in π.; Deiss., BS, 230, _LAE_, 152), [[Luk.15.12|Luk.15:12]]†
(AS)

G1915.def:
**ἐπί-βλημα**, -τος, τό
[in LXX: [[Isa.3.22|Isa.3:22]] * ;]
1. that which is thrown over, a cover.
2. a tapestry, hanging (Is, l.with).
3. **that which is put on**;
(a) **embroidery**;
(b) **a patch**: [[Mat.9.16|Mat.9:16]], [[Mrk.2.21|Mrk.2:21]], [[Luk.5.36|Luk.5:36]].†
(AS)

G1994.def:
**ἐπι-στρέφω **
[very frequently in LXX, chiefly for שׁוּב, in its various senses, also for פָּנָה, etc. ;]
1. trans., to turn about, round or towards, hence metaphorically, **to turn, cause to return **(to God, virtue, etc.): [[Luk.1.16-17|Luk.1:16-17]] (cf. [[Mal.3.24|Mal.3:24]]), [[Jas.5.19-20|Jas.5:19-20]]
2. Intrans.,
(a) **to turn, turn oneself around**: [[Act.16.18|Act.16:18]] with inf., [[Rev.1.12|Rev.1:12]] before πρός, [[Act.9.40|Act.9:40]] so also pass. (cl.), [[Mrk.5.30; 8.33|Mrk.5:30 8:33]], [[Jhn.21.20|Jhn.21:20]]; metaphorically, of turning to God (see Field, _Notes_, 246 ff.), ἐπὶ τ. κύριον (θεόν), [[Act.9.35; 11.21; 14.15; 15.19; 26.20|Act.9:35 11:21 14:15 15:19 26:20]]; πρὸς τ. θεόν, [[1Th.1.9|1Th.1:9]], [[2Co.3.16|2Co.3:16]]; ἀπὸ σκότους εἰς φῶς, [[Act.26.18|Act.26:18]] pass., [[1Pe.2.25|1Pe.2:25]]
(b) **to return **(as in M_Gr._): [[Luk.8.55|Luk.8:55]], [[Act.15.36|Act.15:36]]; before ὀπίσω, with inf., [[Mat.24.18|Mat.24:18]] before εἰς, [[Mat.12.44|Mat.12:44]], [[Mrk.13.16|Mrk.13:16]], [[Luk.2.39; 17.31|Luk.2:39 17:31]]; ἐπί, [[2Pe.2.22|2Pe.2:22]] metaphorically, before ἐπί, [[Gal.4.9|Gal.4:9]] πρός, [[Luk.17.4|Luk.17:4]] of moral reform, [[Mat.13.15|Mat.13:15]], [[Mrk.4.12|Mrk.4:12]], [[Luk.22.32|Luk.22:32]], [[Act.3.19; 28.27|Act.3:19 28:27]]; pass., [[Mat.10.13|Mat.10:13]] (Cremer, 531, 881).†
(AS)

G1941.def:
**ἐπι-καλέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
1. **to call, name, surname**: with accusative (cl.), [[Mat.10.25|Mat.10:25]] pass., [[Act.1.23; 4.36; 10.5, 18; 10.22; 11.13; 12.12, 25|Act.1:23 4:36 10:5, 18 10:22 11:13 12:12, 25]], [[Heb.11.16|Heb.11:16]]; τ. ὄνομα, before ἐπί (denoting possession, as _Heb._ עַל. . שֻׁם קָרָא), [[Act.15.17|Act.15:17]] (LXX), [[Jas.2.7|Jas.2:7]] (see. CB on [[Amo.9.12|Amo.9:12]]).
2. Mid. (so also act.; cl., LXX), **to call upon, invoke, appeal to **(θεόν, θεούς, Hdt., Xen., al.; cf. Deiss., _LAE_, 426): Καίσαρα (Σεβαστόν, [[Act.25.25|Act.25:25]]), [[Act.25.11-12, 21; 26.32; 28.19|Act.25:11-12, 21 26:32 28:19]]; sc. τ. Κύριον Ἰησοῦν, [[Act.7.59|Act.7:59]] μάρτυρα (cl.) τ. θεόν, [[2Co.1.23|2Co.1:23]] πατέρα, [[1Pe.1.17|1Pe.1:17]] τ. κύριον, [[Rom.10.12|Rom.10:12]], [[2Ti.2.22|2Ti.2:22]]; τ. ὄνομα κυρίου (μου, σου; like _Heb._ יְהוָֹה שֻׁם קָרָא), [[Act.2.21|Act.2:21]] (LXX) [[Act.9.14, 21; 22.16|Act.9:14, 21 22:16]], [[Rom.10.13-14|Rom.10:13-14]]" (LXX) [[1Co.1.2|1Co.1:2]] (Cremer, 335, 742).†
(AS)

G1905.def:
**ἐπ-ερωτάω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁאַל, also for דָּרַשׁ, etc. ;]
1. **to in­quire of, consult, question**: with accusative of person(s), [[Mrk.12.34|Mrk.12:34]], [[Luk.2.46|Luk.2:46]], al.; with dupl. accusative, [[Mrk.7.17; 11.29|Mrk.7:17 11:29]], [[Luk.20.40|Luk.20:40]], al.; with accusative of person(s), before λέγων, [[Mat.12.18|Mat.12:18]], [[Mrk.9.11|Mrk.9:11]]; εἰ, [[Mrk.8.23|Mrk.8:23]], [[Luk.23.6|Luk.23:6]], al.; ἐ. θεόν, [[Rom.10.20|Rom.10:20]] (LXX).
2. In late Gk., **to beg of, demand of**: with accusative of person(s) and inf., [[Mat.16.1|Mat.16:1]] (cf. ἐρωτάω; and see Cromer, 716)
(AS)

G1949.def:
**ἐπι-λαμβάνω **
[in LXX for חָזַק hi., אָחַז, etc. ;]
always mid. in LXX and NT (see Cremer, 758), **to lap hold of**: with genitive of person(s), [[Mat.14.31|Mat.14:31]], [[Act.17.19; 21.30, 33|Act.17:19 21:30, 33]]; with accusative of person(s) (not cl.), [[Luk.9.47; 14.4; 23.26|Luk.9:47 14:4 23:26]] (WH, but see Bl., 1015), [[Act.9.27; 16.9; 18.17|Act.9:27 16:9 18:17]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[Mrk.8.23|Mrk.8:23]], [[Act.23.10|Act.23:10]], [[Heb.8.9|Heb.8:9]]" (LXX) ; with genitive of person(s) and of thing(s), [[Luk.20.20, 26|Luk.20:20, 26]]; τ. αἰωνίου (ὄντως) ζωῆς, [[1Ti.6.12; 6.19|1Ti.6:12 6:19]]. Metaphorical (as in [[Sir.4.11|Sir.4:11]]), [[Heb.2.16|Heb.2:16]] (see Westc., in l).†
(AS)

G1925.def:
**ἐπι-δείκνυμι **
[in LXX: [[Pro.12.17|Pro.12:17]] (פּוּחַ hi.), [[Isa.37.26|Isa.37:26]] (בּוֹא hi.), Esp. Jer.59, [[2Ma.15.32|2Ma.15:32]], al ;]
1. **to show, exhibit, display**: with accusative and dative, [[Mat.16.1; 22.19; 24.1|Mat.16:1 22:19 24:1]], [[Luk.17.14|Luk.17:14]]. Mid., **to display for oneself or as one's own **(but cf. El., § 55, 1): [[Act.9.39|Act.9:39]]
2. **to show, point out, prove**: with accusative, [[Heb.6.17|Heb.6:17]] with accusative and inf., [[Act.18.28|Act.18:28]] (cf. MM, _Exp._, xiv).†
(AS)

G1950.def:
**ἐπι-λανθάνομαι**
(alternative mid, form of ἐπιλήθω, to cause to forget) [in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַח ;]
**to forget, neglect**: with inf., [[Mat.16.5|Mat.16:5]], [[Mrk.8.14|Mrk.8:14]]; with genitive, [[Heb.6.10; 13.2, 16|Heb.6:10 13:2, 16]]; with accusative (as occasionally in cl.; MM, _Exp._, xiv), [[Php.3.13|Php.3:13]] ὁποῖος ἦν, [[Jas.1.24|Jas.1:24]] pass. ptcp. (cf. [[Isa.23.16|Isa.23:16]], [[Sir.3.14; 23.14|Sir.3:14 23:14]], [[Wis.2.4|Wis.2:4]]), [[Luk.12.6|Luk.12:6]].†
(AS)

G1982.def:
**ἐπι-σκιάζω **
[in LXX: [[Exo.40.35|Exo.40:35]] (שָׁכַן), [[Psa.91.4; 140.7|Psa.91:4 140:7]] (סָכַךְ), [[Pro.18.11|Pro.18:11]] * ;]
**to throw a shadow upon, overshadow**: with dative, [[Act.5.15|Act.5:15]] of a shining (Mt, l.with, and cf. [[Exo.40.29, 35|Exo.40:29, 35]], [[2Ma.2.8|2Ma.2:8]]) cloud, with dative, [[Mrk.9.7|Mrk.9:7]] with accusative, [[Mat.17.5|Mat.17:5]], [[Luk.9.34|Luk.9:34]]; metaphorically (cf. Pss, Pr, ll.with), of the Holy Spirit, [[Luk.1.35|Luk.1:35]]†
(AS)

G1910.def:
**ἐπι-βαίνω **
[in LXX chiefly for רָכַב ;]
1. **to get up on, mount**: before ἐπί, with accusative, [[Mat.21.5|Mat.21:5]] (LXX); to embark in (a boat), **go aboard**: with dative, [[Act.27.2|Act.27:2]] before εἰς, [[Act.21.6|Act.21:6]] (Rec.); absol., [[Act.21.2|Act.21:2]]
2. **to go up to, go on to, enter**: before εἰς, [[Act.20.18; 21.4|Act.20:18 21:4]]; with dative, [[Act.25.1|Act.25:1]]†
(AS)

G1940.def:
**ἐπι-καθ-ίζω **
[in LXX for רָכַב, etc. ;]
**to sit upon**: [[Mat.21.7|Mat.21:7]]†
(AS)

G1918.def:
**ἐπι-γαμβρεύω**
(γαμβρός, a connection by marriage) [in LXX: [[Gen.34.9|Gen.34:9]], [[1Sa.18.21|1Ki.18:21]] ff., [[2Ch.18.1|2Ch.18:1]], [[Est.9.14|Est.9:14]] (חָתַן hithp.), [[Gen.38.8|Gen.38:8]] R (יָבַם pi.), [[1Ma.10.54-56|1Ma.10:54-56]] * ;]
1. **to enter into affinity with**: with dative (LXX, H. with, exc. [[Gen.38.8|Gen.38:8]]).
2. to marry (as deceased husband's next of kin, cf. [[Gen.38.8|Gen.38:8]]): with accusative, [[Mat.22.24|Mat.22:24]]†
(AS)

G1980.def:
**ἐπι-σκέπτομαι**
(late form of ἐπισκοπέω, which see), [in LXX very freq., chiefly for פָּקַד ;]
1. to inspect, examine.
2. (a) to visit: with accusative, [[Act.7.23; 15.36|Act.7:23 15:36]] (cf. [[Jdg.15.1|Jdg.15:1]]); especially, the sick and afflicted (as in M_Gr._ and sometimes in cl.), [[Mat.25.36, 43|Mat.25:36, 43]], [[Jas.1.27|Jas.1:27]] (cf. [[Sir.7.35|Sir.7:35]]);
(b) in LXX and NT (as פָּקַד in [[Gen.21.1|Gen.21:1]], [[Exo.4.31|Exo.4:31]], [[Psa.8.5|Psa.8:5]], al.), **to visit with help, to care for**: [[Luk.1.68, 78; 7.16|Luk.1:68, 78 7:16]], [[Act.15.14|Act.15:14]], [[Heb.2.6|Heb.2:6]];
(with) to visit with punishment ([[Jer.9.25|Jer.9:25]], [[Psa.89.33|Psa.89:33]], al.; cf. MM, _Exp._, xiv; Cremer, 863).†
(AS)

G1978.def:
**ἐπίσημος**, -ον
(σῆμα, a mark), [in LXX: [[Gen.30.42|Gen.30:42]] (קָשַׁר), [[Est.5.4; 8.13|Est.5:4 8:13]], [[1Ma.11.37|1Ma.11:37]] [[1Mac.14.48|1Mac 14:48]], [[2Ma.15.36|2Ma.15:36]], [[3Ma.6.1|3Ma.6:1]] * ;]
1. **bearing a mark**; of money, stamped, coined.
2. Metaphorical,
(a) **in good sense, notable, illustrious**: [[Rom.16.7|Rom.16:7]]
(b) **in bad sense, notorious**: [[Mat.27.16|Mat.27:16]]†
(AS)

G1976.def:
**ἐπι-ράπτω** (Rec. -ρράπτω),
**to sew upon**: before ἐπί, with accusative, [[Mrk.2.21|Mrk.2:21]]†
(AS)

G1968.def:
**ἐπι-πίπτω **
[in LXX chiefly for נָפַל ;]
**to fall upon **(Field, _Notes_, 25): with dative of person(s), [[Mrk.3.10|Mrk.3:10]] (see Swete, in l), [[Act.20.10|Act.20:10]] before ἐπὶ τ. τράχηλον (as [[Gen.46.29|Gen.46:29]], [[Tob.11.8|Tob.11:8]], [[3Ma.5.49|3Ma.5:49]], al.), [[Luk.15.20|Luk.15:20]], [[Act.20.37|Act.20:37]]. Metaphorical, φόβος, [[Luk.1.12|Luk.1:12]], [[Act.19.17|Act.19:17]], [[Rev.11.11|Rev.11:11]]; ὀνειδισμοί, [[Rom.15.3|Rom.15:3]] (LXX); of the Holy Spirit: before ἐπί, with dative, [[Act.8.16|Act.8:16]] ἐπί, with accusative, [[Act.10.44; 11.15|Act.10:44 11:15]]; absol., [[Act.23.7|Act.23:7]]†
(AS)

G1939.def:
**ἐπιθυμία**, -ας, ἡ
(έπιθυμέω), [in LXX chiefly for תַּאֲוָה, אָוָה; also for חֶמֶד, etc. ;]
**desire, longing**: [[Luk.22.15|Luk.22:15]] (see: ἐπιθυμέω), [[Php.1.23|Php.1:23]], [[1Th.2.17|1Th.2:17]], [[Rev.18.14|Rev.18:14]]; p1., [[Mrk.4.19|Mrk.4:19]] esp. with ref. to forbidden things, **desire, lust **(Vg., concupiscentia): [[Rom.7.7-8|Rom.7:7-8]], [[Jas.1.14-15|Jas.1:14-15]], [[2Pe.1.4|2Pe.1:4]]; pl., [[Gal.5.24|Gal.5:24]], [[1Ti.6.9|1Ti.6:9]], [[2Ti.2.22; 4.3|2Ti.2:22 4:3]], [[1Pe.1.14; 4.2|1Pe.1:14 4:2]]; πάθος ἐπιθυμίας, [[1Th.4.5|1Th.4:5]] ἐ. κακή, [[Col.3.5|Col.3:5]] with genitive, μιασμοῦ, [[2Pe.2.10|2Pe.2:10]] (see Mayor, in l); τ. καρδιῶν, [[Rom.1.24|Rom.1:24]] τ. κόσμου (aroused by the world), [[1Jn.2.17|1Jn.2:17]] τ. σώματος, [[Rom.6.12|Rom.6:12]] τ. ἀπάτης, [[Eph.4.22|Eph.4:22]] (see _ICC_, in l); τ. σαρκός, [[1Jn.2.16|1Jn.2:16]], [[2Pe.2.18|2Pe.2:18]] (without art.), [[Gal.5.16|Gal.5:16]] τ. ὀφθαλμῶν, [[1Jn.2.16|1Jn.2:16]] σαρκικαὶ ἐ., [[1Pe.2.11|1Pe.2:11]] (cf. [[4Ma.1.32|4Ma.1:32]]); κοσμικαί, [[Tit.2.12|Tit.2:12]] εἰς ἐπιθυμίας, [[Rom.13.14|Rom.13:14]] ποιεῖν τὰς ἐ., [[Jhn.8.44|Jhn.8:44]] ὑπακούειν ταῖς ἐ., [[Rom.6.12|Rom.6:12]] δουλεύειν, ἄγεσθαι, ἐπιθυμίαις, [[Tit.3.3|Tit.3:3]], [[2Ti.3.6|2Ti.3:6]]; πορεύειθαι ἐν ἐ., [[1Pe.4.3|1Pe.4:3]] κατά, [[Jude.16,18|Ju 16 18]], [[2Pe.3.3|2Pe.3:3]]; ἀναστρέφεσθαι ἐν ταῖς ἐ., [[Eph.2.3|Eph.2:3]]†
_SYN._: πάθος (which see), ὄρεξις (AS)

G1998.def:
**ἐπι-συν-τρέχω **
**to run together again**: [[Mrk.9.25|Mrk.9:25]] (see Swete, in l).†
(AS)

G1987.def:
**ἐπίσταμαι**
(prob. an old mid, of ἐφίστημι, which see), [in LXX chiefly for יָדַע ;]
**to know, know of, understand**: with accusative of person(s), [[Act.19.15|Act.19:15]] with ptcp., [[Act.24.10|Act.24:10]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mrk.14.68|Mrk.14:68]], [[Act.18.25|Act.18:25]], [[1Ti.6.4|1Ti.6:4]], [[Jas.4.14|Jas.4:14]], [[Jude.10|Ju 10]]; before περί, [[Act.26.26|Act.26:26]] ὅτι, [[Act.15.7; 19.25; 22.19|Act.15:7 19:25 22:19]]; ὡς, [[Act.10.28|Act.10:28]] πῶς, [[Act.20.18|Act.20:18]] ποῦ, [[Heb.11.8|Heb.11:8]]†
**SYN**: γινώσκω (which see), οἶδα
(AS)

G1924.def:
**ἐπι-γράφω **
[in LXX for כָּתַב, [[Num.17.2|Num.17:2]] fig., [[Jer.31.33|Jer.31:33]], al. ;]
**to write upon, inscribe**: [[Mrk.15.26|Mrk.15:26]], [[Act.17.23|Act.17:23]], [[Rev.21.12|Rev.21:12]]; figuratively, [[Heb.8.10|Heb.8:10]] (LXX) [[Heb.10.16|Heb.10:16]]†
(AS)

G1904.def:
**ἐπ-έρχομαι**,
[in LXX for בּוֹא, עָבַר, etc. ;]
1. **to come to, arrive, come on**: before ἀπό, with genitive loc., [[Act.14.19|Act.14:19]] (ἐπῆλθαν; cf. M, _Pr._, 65; Deiss., BS, 191); of time, [[Eph.2.7|Eph.2:7]]
2. **to come upon **(as in Hom.): of calamities, [[Luk.21.26|Luk.21:26]], [[Act.8.24; 13.40|Act.8:24 13:40]], [[Jas.5.1|Jas.5:1]]; of an enemy, [[Luk.11.22|Luk.11:22]] of the Holy Spirit, [[Luk.1.35|Luk.1:35]], [[Act.1.8|Act.1:8]], [in LXX: γίγνομαι ἐπί, [[Jdg.14.6|Jdg.14:6]], [[1Ki.11.6|3Ki.11:6]], al.].†
(AS)

G1914.def:
**ἐπι-βλέπω **
[in LXX for נָבַט hi., פָּנָה, רָאָה, etc. ;]
to look upon. In NT, as in LXX ([[1Ki.1.11; 9.1|1Ki.1:11 9:1]], [[Psa.25.16|Psa.25:16]] [[Tob.3.3|Tob.3:3]], al.), **to look on with favour**: before ἐπί with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.1.48; 9.38|Luk.1:48 9:38]], [[Jas.2.3|Jas.2:3]].†
(AS)

G1945.def:
**ἐπι-κείμαι **
[in LXX: [[Exo.39.31|Exo.39:31]] (נָתַן), [[Job.19.3|Job.19:3]] (הָכַר hi.) [[Job.21.27|Job.21:27]] (חָמַס), [[1Ma.6.57|1Ma.6:57]], [[2Ma.1.21|2Ma.1:21]], [[3Ma.1.22|3Ma.1:22]] * ;]
**to be placed, lie on**: [[Jhn.21.9|Jhn.21:9]] before ἐπί, with dative, [[Jhn.11.38|Jhn.11:38]] figuratively, [[Heb.9.10|Heb.9:10]] ἀνάγκη, [[1Co.9.16|1Co.9:16]] χειμῶν, **to threaten, come on**: [[Act.27.20|Act.27:20]] of persons, **to press upon**: [[Luk.5.1; 23.23|Luk.5:1 23:23]].†
(AS)

G1908.def:
**ἐπηρεάζω**
(ἐπήρεια, spiteful abuse),
**to revile**: with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.6.28|Luk.6:28]] with accusative of thing(s) (but see _ICC_, in l), [[1Pe.3.16|1Pe.3:16]]†
(AS)

G1975.def:
**ἐπι-πορεύομαι **
[in LXX: [[Lev.26.33|Lev.26:33]] (אָחַר), [[Ezk.39.14|Eze.39:14]] (עָבַר), Ep. [[Jer.6.2|Jer.6:2]], [[2Ma.2.28|2Ma.2:28]], [[3Ma.1.4|3Ma.1:4]] * ;]
**to travel, journey to**: before πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.8.4|Luk.8:4]]†
(AS)

G1979.def:
**ἐπισιτισμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐπισιτίζομαι, to supply with provisions), [in LXX: [[Gen.42.25|Gen.42:25]], al. (צֵידָה), [[Jdt.2.18; 4.5|Jdth.2:18 4:5]] ;]
1. a foraging.
2. **provisions, food**: [[Luk.9.12|Luk.9:12]]†
(AS)

G1913.def:
**ἐπι-βιβάζω **
[in LXX chiefly for רָכַב hi. ;]
**to place upon**: with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.10.34; 19.35|Luk.10:34 19:35]], [[Act.23.24|Act.23:24]].†
(AS)

G1907.def:
**ἐπ-έχω **
[in LXX for חָדַל, etc.; also [[Sir.8.1; 34.2|Sir.8:1 34:2]], [[2Ma.5.25|2Ma.5:25]] [[2Mac.9.25|2Mac 9:25]], al. ;]
1. to hold upon.
2. Like παρέχω (as in Hom., al.), **to hold out, offer**: λόγον ζωῆς, [[Php.2.16|Php.2:16]]
3. to hold or direct towards, Sc.νοῦν;
(a) absol., to intend, purpose;
(b) **to observe, give attention to **(see MM, _Exp._, xiv): before πῶς, [[Luk.14.7|Luk.14:7]] with dative of person(s), [[Act.3.5|Act.3:5]], [[1Ti.4.16|1Ti.4:16]].
4. **to stay, wait**: [[Act.19.22|Act.19:22]] (in legal phrase, MM, _Exp._, l.with).†
(AS)

G1977.def:
**ἐπι-ρίπτω**
(Rec. -ρρίπτω, as in cl.), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלַךְ hi. ;]
1. to cast at.
2. **to cast or place upon**: with accusative before ἐπί, with accusative, [[Luk.19.35|Luk.19:35]] metaphorically, τ. μέριμναν, [[1Pe.5.7|1Pe.5:7]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G1984.def:
**ἐπι-σκοπή**, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX chiey for פָּקַד פְּקֻדָּה ;]
1. **a visiting, visitation **(εἰς ἐ. τοῦ παιδός, Lucian, dial. deor., 20, 6); as in LXX (after _Heb._), of God's visitation in mercy, or in judgment ([[Lev.19.20|Lev.19:20]] [[Job.10.12|Job.10:12]], [[Jer.6.15|Jer.6:15]], [[Wis.2.20|Wis.2:20]], al.): [[Luk.19.44|Luk.19:44]], [[1Pe.2.12|1Pe.2:12]] (see Hort, in l).
2. office, charge, esp. office of an ἐπίσκοιος (which see): [[Act.1.20|Act.1:20]] (LXX), [[1Ti.3.1|1Ti.3:1]] (Cremer, 527 f., 864; _DCG_, ii, 809b).†
(AS)

G1948.def:
**ἐπι-κρίνω **
[in LXX: [[2Ma.4.47|2Ma.4:47]], [[3Ma.4.2|3Ma.4:2]] * ;]
**to decree, give sentence**: with accusative and inf., [[Luk.23.24|Luk.23:24]]†
(AS)

G1919.def:
**ἐπί-γειος**, -ον
(ἐπί, γῆ),
**of the earth, earthly**: τὰ ἐ., [[Jhn.3.12|Jhn.3:12]] [[Php.2.10; 3.19|Php.2:10 3:19]] (anarth.); σώματα, [[1Co.15.40|1Co.15:40]] οἰκία, [[2Co.5.1|2Co.5:1]] σοφία, [[Jas.3.15|Jas.3:15]] (Cremer, 153).†
(AS)

G1951.def:
**ἐπι-λέγω **
[in LXX chiefly for בָּחַר ;]
1. to say in addition (Hdt.).
2. **to call by name, to call**: [[Jhn.5.2|Jhn.5:2]]
3. **to choose**; mid., **to choose for oneself**: [[Act.15.40|Act.15:40]]†
(AS)

G1903.def:
**ἐπενδύτης**, -ου, ὁ
(ἐπενδύω), [in LXX for מְעִיל [[Lev.8.7|Lev.8:7]] A (Aq. ἐπένδυμα), [[1Ki.18.4|3Ki.18:4]] A, [[2Ki.13.18|4Ki.13:18]] * ;]
**an outer tunic **(RV, coat): [[Jhn.21.7|Jhn.21:7]] .†
(AS)

G1927.def:
**ἐπι-δημέω**, -ῶ
(δῆμος);
1. to be at home (Thuc., Plat., al.),
2. **to stay in a place, sojourn **(Plat., Xen., al.; and see MM, _Exp._, xiv): [[Act.2.10; 17.21|Act.2:10 17:21]]; before ἐν, [[Act.18.27|Act.18:27]] (WH, mg.).†
(AS)

G1966.def:
**ἔπ-ειμι **
[in LXX: [[Exo.8.22|Exo.8:22]] (עָמַד), [[Sir.42.19|Sir.42:19]], etc. ;]
1. **to come upon, approach **
2. **Of time, to come on or after**; mostly as ptcp., ἐπιών, -οῦσα, όν, **next, following**: τῇ- ἔ. (sc.ἡμέρᾳ, as frequently in late Gk.), [[Act.16.11; 20.15; 21.18|Act.16:11 20:15 21:18]]; ἡμέρᾳ (as usual in cl.), [[Act.7.26|Act.7:26]] νυκτί, [[Act.23.11|Act.23:11]]†
(AS)

G1900.def:
**ἐπ-έκεινα **
_adv._ (= ἐπ᾽ ἐκεῖνα), [in LXX: [[Lev.22.27|Lev.22:27]], [[Num.32.19|Num.32:19]], al. (הָלְאָה), etc. ;]
**beyond**; with genitive, [[Act.7.43|Act.7:43]] (LXX) †
(AS)

G1936.def:
**ἐπί-θεσις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἐπιτίθημι), [in LXX: [[2Ch.25.27|2Ch.25:27]] (קֶשֶׁר), [[Ezk.23.11|Ez 23:11]] (עֲגָבָה) [[2Ma.4.41|2Ma.4:41]] [[2Mac.5.5|2Mac 5:5]] [[2Mac.14.15|2Mac 14:15]] * ;]
1. **a laying on**: χειρῶν, [[Act.8.18|Act.8:18]], [[1Ti.4.14|1Ti.4:14]], [[2Ti.1.6|2Ti.1:6]], [[Heb.6.2|Heb.6:2]] (cf. Westc., He., l.with; CGT on 1Ti, l.with).
2. an attack, assault (2Mac, ll.with).†
(AS)

G1992.def:
**ἐπι-στολή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιατέλλω), [in LXX for אִגֶּרֶת, etc.; frequently in Mac ;]
1. a message.
2. **a letter, an epistle**: [[Act.9.2|Act.9:2]], [[1Co.5.9|1Co.5:9]], al.; pl., [[Act.22.5|Act.22:5]], [[1Co.16.3|1Co.16:3]], al.; ἐ. σνστατικαί, [[2Co.3.1|2Co.3:1]] (cf. Milligan, _NTD_, 254 f.). (On the NT ἐπιστολαί, cf. Milligan, _Th._, 121 ff.; _NTD_, 85 ff.; Deiss., BS, 3 ff.; St. Paul, 8 ff.)
(AS)

G1961.def:
**ἐπι-μένω **
[in LXX: [[Exo.12.39|Exo.12:39]] (מָהַהּ hith.)* ;]
**to stay on, tarry or abide still**: before έν, [[1Co.16.8|1Co.16:8]] αὐτοῦ, there, [[Act.15.34|Act.15:34]] (WH, txt., RV, txt., omit) [[Act.21.4|Act.21:4]] with dative, τ. σαρκί, [[Php.1.24|Php.1:24]] before παρά, with dative of person(s), [[Act.28.14|Act.28:14]] πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[1Co.16.7|1Co.16:7]], [[Gal.1.18|Gal.1:18]]; with accusative temp., [[Act.10.48; 21.4, 10; 28.12, 14|Act.10:48 21:4, 10 28:12, 14]], [[1Co.16.7|1Co.16:7]]. Metaphorical, **to continue in a pursuit or state**: with dative, τ. ἀμαρτίᾳ, [[Rom.6.1|Rom.6:1]] τ. ὰπιστίᾳ, [[Rom.11.23|Rom.11:23]] τ. πίστει, [[Col.1.23|Col.1:23]] αὐτοῖς (see CGT, in l), [[1Ti.4.16|1Ti.4:16]] τ. χρηστότητι, [[Rom.11.22|Rom.11:22]] with ptcp. (cf. Bl., § 73, 4; 76, 2), [[Jhn.8.7|Jhn.8:7]], [[Act.12.16|Act.12:16]].†
(AS)

G1991.def:
**ἐπι-στηρίζω **
[in LXX for סָמַךְ, etc. ;]
**to make stronger, confirm**: with accusative, [[Act.14.22; 15.32, 41|Act.14:22 15:32, 41]].†
(AS)

G1995.def:
**ἐπι-στροφή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιστρέφω) [in LXX: [[Ezk.47.7|Eze.47:7]] (שׁוּב), [[Sir.18.21; 49.2|Sir.18:21 49:2]], etc. ;]
**a turning about**; metaphorically, **conversion **(Field, _Notes_, 246): [[Act.15.3|Act.15:3]]†
(AS)

G1989.def:
**ἐπι-στέλλω **
[in LXX: [[3Ki.5.8|3Ki.5:8]] [[Neh.6.19|Neh.6:19]] (שָׁלַח), [[Jdt.15.4|Jdth.15:4]], [[1Ma.10.25|1Ma.10:25]] [[1Mac.12.7|1Mac 12:7]] [[1Mac.13.18|1Mac 13:18]] (in each case with seel. ἀποσ-) * ;]
1. to send to.
